name: President Donald J. Trump International Airport (formerly Palm Beach International)

runway.v: the largest runway is 10,000 ft × 150 ft (about 3,048 m × 46 m); runways shown are 10L-28R, 10R-28L and 14-32

customs.v: CBP clears aircraft 7 days a week 09:00–19:00 (office hours 08:00–20:00 Eastern Time); contact CBP at least 4 hours before leaving the foreign port; FIS facility on its own ramp, not attached to an FBO or the terminal

hours.quote: The airport has a 24-hour control tower and a U.S. Customs & Border Protection port of entry facility.

handling.v: three full-service FBOs (not named on the page); general aviation uses the south side of the field and may not use the north ramps without the Department's approval
handling.quote: three full service fixed base operators

noise.v: voluntary noise abatement procedures from a Part 150 study; no penalty for not using them; the page gives no hours or procedure details
noise.quote: there is no penalty for failing to utilize noise abatement procedures.

notes: Operator is the Palm Beach County Department of Airports; its site now names the airport 'President Donald J. Trump International Airport' (DJT); CBP's fact sheet (7 Mar 2024) uses KPBI. The voluntary night restraint could not be verified: pbia.org/noise redirects to https://flydjt.org/noise/ and that page, and https://discover.pbc.gov/airports/pages/noise-abatement.aspx, were blocked; the two Part 150 documents opened were for Lantana (LNA), not this airport. The CBP sheet gives no time zone on the 0900-1900 line; Eastern Time is given for office hours. KPBI is not in the US AIP AD 2 Florida page. ft to m conversion mine (1 ft = 0.3048 m). 1 Nov 2026: the County's Noise Abatement page (https://discover.pbc.gov/Airports/Pages/Noise-Abatement.aspx) now opens but only says the Noise Abatement Office enforces noise rules at the airport; it gives no hours or procedures. https://flydjt.org/noise/ could not be opened (permission request not answered). Nothing added. | 3 Nov 2026: IMPORTANT, the County's Name Change FAQs say the name changed on 9 Jul 2026, 'The ICAO identifier changed to “KDJT.”' and the IATA code changed from PBI to DJT on 18 Aug 2026; the FAA chart valid 29 Oct to 26 Nov 2026 (https://aeronav.faa.gov/d-tpp/2611/00449PALMBEACH.PDF) shows 'PRESIDENT DONALD J TRUMP INTL(DJT)'. This file is still named KPBI: the owner should decide on renaming. The Noise FAQ also says 'Airports in the United States are required to be open 24 hours a day and cannot restrict operations due to federal law.'; this is a general statement and does not name a curfew at this airport, so curfew is not recorded as none. The FBO list PDF (https://assets.simpleviewinc.com/simpleview/image/upload/v1/clients/pbi/DOA_Fixed_Base_Operator_List_3_19_24_9e736a13-c382-48f6-afcb-7e2ae080bee6.pdf) was not opened (permission request not answered), so FBO names stay missing. The Runway Use page and FAA Noise Regulations page have no night or voluntary hours.
